title: iRacing Track Guide Mid-Ohio - Short | Skip Barber | 1:17.683

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: hunting for 100 meter board, gently lift off throttle, break immediately
corners.line: miss yellow curb on apex, don't run fully out wide
corners.exit: get on full throttle as early as possible
corners.mistakes: be warned about spins around here

corners.label: T3
corners.line: turn into apex nice and early
corners.exit: stay as far left as you can
corners.mistakes: be careful with running out wide

corners.braking: a couple of car lengths before the repaved bit, slight graze of the brake
corners.gear: get a really really good x here
corners.line: trying to miss the curve as much as you can

corners.braking: at the 200 meter board, just a slight graze
corners.gear: get the car turned in nice and early, get out full throttle as early as you can
corners.line: get a nice straight line over that brow
corners.exit: get a good exit about now, get on full throttle as early as you can
corners.mistakes: do not cut the last corner if you nick a little bit of that grass it's an off

general_tips: cut some grass again use all that curb don't run too far wide the track comes back at you as well
Be cautious with tyres, take a few laps to warm up
